reason: The text describes the Israelites doing evil and Yahweh's consequent punishment by selling them into captivity (וַיִּמְכְּרֵם יְהוָה בְּיַד יָבִין), which demonstrates Yahweh's disapproval through action rather than explicit complaint. Notably, no direct speech from Yahweh expressing complaint appears in this passage. The text does contain the Israelites crying out to the LORD (וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה), but this is their plea, not Yahweh's complaint. The passage presents Yahweh's reaction as judicial punishment, not as a verbal complaint.
